description: This file contains a PHP class and constants related to rendering barcodes using the GD graphics library. It defines a class 'BarcodeObject' with methods for generating barcode images and manages styles, colors, and drawing operations for barcodes.

classes.name: BarcodeObject
classes.description: A class for rendering barcodes in PHP using the GD library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new BarcodeObject with specified dimensions and style.

methods.name: __destructor
methods.description: Destroys the image resource when the object is destroyed.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the GD image resource associated with the barcode.

methods.name: DrawObject
methods.description: Abstract method intended for drawing the barcode; no implementation in base class.

methods.name: DrawBorder
methods.description: Draws a rectangle border around the barcode image.

methods.name: DrawChar
methods.description: Draws a character at a specified position.

methods.name: DrawText
methods.description: Draws a string of text at a specified position.

methods.name: DrawSingleBar
methods.description: Draws a single barcode bar at a specified position and size.

methods.name: GetFontHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of a font.

methods.name: GetFontWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of a font.

methods.name: SetFont
methods.description: Sets the font type for drawing text.

methods.name: FlushObject
methods.description: Outputs the barcode image to the browser in PNG or JPEG format, optionally drawing a border.
